label: Some thought episode occurs under the supplied occurrence predicate, by Existential instantiation…
meaning: Cogito by retorsion: some doubt whether thought occurs is performed (OPEN), and every performed doubt of that kind is realized by an occurring thought episode (OPEN); hence some thought episode occurs. The middle term is the performed doubting act, a separate carrier from thought episodes. Both premises stay open; the conclusion is relocated to the inquirer's own performed act and the doubting-is-thinking bridge. Nothing about a bearer, substance or concreteness follows.
